families.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, "Cascadia Mono", Consolas, monospace

styles.name: display
styles.usage: The wordmark on the lock screen, greeter and splash.

styles.name: emblem
styles.usage: Theme names on the picker card, the system name in About, the wordmark in system info. Names only, one or two words.

styles.name: clock
styles.usage: The stacked clock of the lock screen: hours over minutes, very light.

styles.name: title-lg
styles.usage: The one large line of a panel: the date.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Dialog titles, page titles in settings.

styles.name: aside
styles.usage: Italic asides: calendar month, panel headings, track titles, empty states, plate captions.

styles.name: note
styles.usage: The second line in serif: where a hit of Search lives, what a key opens, the caption of an engraving.

styles.name: motto
styles.usage: The motto and greetings. Lowercase, spaced, italic. One line, never a label.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Installs every package the app needs.
styles.usage: Running text, list rows, field text, code and the terminal.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Labels and the left side of a label :: value pair. Semibold, sentence case.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Descriptions, the top bar, the dock, help text, segmented labels.

styles.name: micro
styles.usage: Badges, key hints, timestamps. Nothing smaller exists.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: What is typed: commands, paths, key names.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between an icon and its value; padding inside the pill.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between related controls; gap from pill to panel.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Padding of buttons and segments. Gap between tiled windows.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Padding of panels, cards and windows. Side inset of the top bar.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Padding of dialogs; gap between groups.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between sections.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Outer margin of full-screen layouts.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Left inset of the lock screen column.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Marks: key caps, badges, the checkbox, a calendar day.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Every plate and every control: windows, panels, cards, notifications, buttons, fields, list rows, the buttons of the top bar.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Switch, radio, count badges, progress.

tokens.name: shadow-pop
tokens.usage: Small floating parts: toolbar, tooltip.

tokens.name: shadow-window
tokens.usage: Tiled and floating windows.

tokens.name: shadow-panel
tokens.usage: Panels, dialogs, menus, notifications.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus on every control: a 2px gap in background, then 2px of focus.

tokens.name: line-hair
tokens.usage: Every border and divider.

tokens.name: line-bold
tokens.usage: The filled part of a progress line and of a ring. Tracks stay at one pixel.

tokens.name: control
tokens.usage: Height of everything that is pressed or typed into: buttons, fields, list rows, the buttons of the top bar.

tokens.name: mark
tokens.usage: Height of the small marks: key caps, badges, the switch.

tokens.name: icon
tokens.usage: Edge of an icon, of the checkbox and of the radio button.

tokens.name: bar-height
tokens.usage: What the top bar takes from the screen: the margin to the edge and one control.

tokens.name: dock-rest
tokens.usage: Height of the dock at rest: a thin tab on the bottom edge.

tokens.name: dur-instant
tokens.usage: Press feedback, menu hover.

tokens.name: dur-fast
tokens.usage: Hover, focus, tooltips, small fades, border colour.

tokens.name: dur-base
tokens.usage: Switch, segmented thumb, tab change, dialogs, list items entering.

tokens.name: dur-slow
tokens.usage: Panel growing out of the pill, carousel, windows opening and moving, window focus, workspace change, rolling numbers.

tokens.name: dur-reveal
tokens.usage: Circular reveal of a new theme, unlocking, ring gauges filling.

tokens.name: dur-loop
tokens.usage: One pass of an indeterminate progress line.

tokens.name: theme-cycle
tokens.usage: How often the theme of the desktop changes by itself to another god, unless kept in the theme picker.

tokens.name: stagger
tokens.usage: Delay between neighbours when a list enters.

tokens.name: ease-out
tokens.usage: Things arriving: open, enter, hover.

tokens.name: ease-in
tokens.usage: Things leaving: close, dismiss.

tokens.name: ease-in-out
tokens.usage: Things travelling: thumb, carousel, workspace change, reveal.

tokens.name: ease-spring
tokens.usage: A small overshoot: switch thumb, check mark, window pop.

tokens.name: dim-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled controls.

tokens.name: dim-inactive
tokens.usage: Inactive windows.

tokens.name: dim-wallpaper
tokens.usage: Wallpaper brightness under the lock screen and the theme picker.

tokens.name: glass
tokens.usage: How much of a floating surface covers what is behind it: panels, dialogs, menus, the search. The compositor blurs the rest.

tokens.name: glass-line
tokens.usage: The hair line around smoked glass: the text colour at this opacity, so the edge reads on the dark and on the lit part of a plate.

usage.background: Desktop behind everything, boot splash, installer. Tinted faintly toward the god in each theme. Ground for text, text-muted, accent-text, error.
usage.surface: Windows, panels, the pill, cards, dialogs. Ground for text, text-muted, accent-text, error.
usage.border: Decorative lines and frames on surface and background: inactive window border, dividers, progress track.
usage.text: Primary text on background, surface and surface-raised (13.9:1 or more). Wordmark, slider thumb.
usage.text-muted: Secondary text and resting icons on background, surface and surface-raised (6.2:1 or more).
usage.accent: The colour of the theme: Strix red under Saturnus, the default, and one muted hue per god. Fills only: main action, selected segment, active workspace, active window border, running progress, cursor, the disc of the wallpaper. Not for text; use accent-text.
usage.on-accent: Text and icons on accent, accent-hover and accent-pressed (4.5:1 or more in every theme): white on dark accents, near-black on light ones.
usage.focus: Focus ring, 2px, after a 2px gap in background. 4.0:1 or more on background, surface and surface-raised in every theme.
usage.error: Error text and the border of a field in error, on background, surface and surface-raised (6.3:1 or more). Always with words.
usage.warning: Warnings as text or icon with words, on background and surface (7.7:1 or more). Never a filled box.
usage.surface-raised: Hover and selected rows, tooltips, the cover of a media card. One step above surface.
usage.surface-sunken: Wells: text fields, switch track, segmented track.
usage.border-strong: Borders that carry meaning: controls, secondary buttons, tooltips. 3.2:1 or more on every surface.
usage.border-active: The border of the focused window: the accent quietened toward border, so focus shows without glowing. About 2:1 on background; inactive windows are dimmed as well, so focus never rests on this colour alone.
usage.text-faint: Placeholders, line numbers, timestamps, the :: separator. 3.6:1 or more: never for text a person must read.
usage.accent-text: The accent as text or icon on background, surface, surface-raised and accent-soft (5.2:1 or more): the list caret, the power icon, links.
usage.accent-soft: Quiet ground in the accent hue: hover of a danger button, selection in text.
usage.line: Cream line work: wallpaper drawing, bracket frames, the edge of the selected theme card. Drawn at 1px, usually at reduced opacity.
usage.scrim: Dimming layer under dialogs, the session menu and the theme picker.
usage.success: Success as text or icon with words, on background and surface (7.8:1 or more).
usage.info: Neutral information as text or icon with words, on background and surface (7.1:1 or more).
usage.syntax-comment: Code: comments, set italic. 4.6:1 or more on background and surface.
usage.chart-1: Charts: the series that matters. Also the peak bars of the visualizer.
usage.chart-3: Charts: third series, and bars at rest.
usage.chart-5: Charts: fifth series. Series differ in lightness, so they hold without colour.

term_usage.selection: Terminal selection ground; foreground stays readable on it.
